resources.string: Record visible coordinates and follow saved waypoints

For fixed-view maps with visible integer X/Y coordinates. Not touch or video recording. Keep the same camera, movement speed and resolution. Stop normal scenario execution first. Routes are local to this device and are not included in scenario backups.
1. Select coordinate fields and map marker

Select only the X digits, then only the Y digits. Leave room for all digits; never include the comma or the other coordinate. Select a fixed map name/icon as the map marker. Move this toolbar away from these areas.

A/B are two direction samples, not the start and end of the route. Replay does not alternate between A/B: they map screen input to changes in map coordinates.\n\nStand still, choose nearby clear ground outside the character, then run A. Repeat B in another direction, roughly perpendicular. For ground taps the camera must follow the character so their feet stay at the anchor. Recalibrate after changing camera or speed; recorded points can be kept.

Record while walking normally, then tap Finish. New recordings keep old routes; drafts are saved every 5 seconds but cannot replay. Stand near the start to replay. Dense straight samples are combined; turns and the endpoint still require confirmation. This is not timed gesture playback: recognition and checks add time. At the endpoint, use Return along route.

Stand near the recorded endpoint. The app will follow the saved waypoints in reverse, without crossing the whole map directly or changing your recording.\n\nCheck that the path is reversible. One-way gates, drops, teleports and doors needing interaction are not supported. It pauses if stuck. At the start, tap Replay yourself; this does not start an automatic loop.
Approach range: ≤ %1$.1f position units; exact coordinates are not required. Stand still with a clear path nearby. Distant or arbitrary mid-route entry is not supported.
Delete this route? This cannot be undone.
Loaded “%1$s”. Settings above now belong to this route; check replay requirements.
Route no longer exists. Your current configuration was not changed.
New empty route created. Existing routes are kept.
Starting: %1$s. Check the floating status panel that opens next.
✓ Ready. Stand near the start and tap Replay: the app approaches the start before following the entire route. At the endpoint, use Return along route.
Select a valid X coordinate area.
Select a valid Y coordinate area.
Select the minimap interior and capture its reference at the start.
Select a fixed map name/icon area.
Capture the map marker reference image.
Select the character feet / fixed joystick center.

Pass the minimap localization test first.
Complete A: select its target, then run calibration A. Existing waypoints are kept.
Complete B: select a target in another direction, then run calibration B. Existing waypoints are kept.
Select calibration A target before running calibration A.
Select calibration B target in a different direction before running calibration B.
This is a draft. Record a route and tap Finish at the destination.
Fewer than two valid waypoints. Record a route with actual movement.
Area updated. Complete capture and calibration as shown above.
Movement center set. Recalibrate A and B; existing waypoints are kept.
Hold duration changed. Recalibrate A and B.
A target selected. Next, run calibration A (moves).
B target selected. Next, run calibration B (moves).

Calibration A complete. Finish B, then save both directions.
Calibration B complete. Finish A, then save both directions.
✓ Calibration saved to the original route; no re-recording needed. Replay near the start, or return along the route from near its endpoint.
✓ Both directions calibrated. Save configuration or record a new route next.
Recording saved. Waypoint count: %1$d. Check calibration before replay.
Route deleted. A new empty configuration is now open.
Operation stopped/cancelled; arrival was not confirmed. Check the current route status.
Complete the selections first. Use valid non-overlapping areas and a name of at most 60 characters.
Could not complete or save. Check free storage and configuration.
Returned to the recorded start; ready to replay
Not moving: too far from the recorded endpoint
Moving in small steps. Do not steer manually; Pause remains available.
Walk within the allowed range, stop, then tap Resume. Exact alignment is unnecessary. At the endpoint, finish this operation and choose Return along route.
Walk within range of the endpoint, stop, then tap Resume. Exact alignment is unnecessary.
Paused — no more moves will be sent
Draft saved; record again before replay
Not moving: too far from the recorded start
Coordinates or map lost. Replay paused; recording draft kept.
Calibration failed: use two clear, different directions
Stopped: screen capture unavailable or a scenario is running
Install the text detection and Latin OCR models in Settings first
Paused: gesture failed or overlaps toolbar / coordinate area
Recording limit reached (2,000 points); draft kept

Experimental: fixed layout, north-up, fixed zoom, player centred while the map scrolls. Select the map interior (96–512 pixels per side), excluding the border and HUD; the player must be at its centre. Rotating maps, random dungeons and moving player markers are not supported. Select a separate static map name/icon below.

Capture the reference, then test: walk slowly a short distance. Requires 20 reliable observations, at least 80% success and 12 normalized pixels of travel within 2 minutes. Return to the reference position before recording. No movement is allowed until the test passes.
Insufficient map features / unstable localization; movement disabled
Recent localization trace, up to 120 points

Fixed joystick only. Choose two perpendicular offsets beyond its deadzone, within its effective radius. Playback keeps that deflection and shortens the hold near waypoints. Change speed or hold duration? Recalibrate. Each gesture releases within 800 ms; no simultaneous attack touches.
Follow a saved route, then continue the next action

Record, test and save the route under Scenario → More → Routes first. This action follows it once, sequentially. On failure the scenario stops. Routes are local and not included in scenario backups; reselect a route after importing on another device. Split a journey into routes to insert battle or door interaction actions between segments. Timeout includes debugger pauses.
No calibrated, completed routes. Create one in Scenario → More → Routes.
Paused: position changed unexpectedly. Return to the last position.
Walk back, stand still, then tap Resume to recheck.
Recorded start: %1$s → End: %2$s\nThey can differ. Replay approaches the start from nearby; Return follows the route back from near the endpoint.
